offering_description.value: Provides less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation for industrial, retail and commercial shippers in North America and Europe. Operates a network of terminals, line-haul and local delivery trucks, and also offers truck brokerage and last-mile services.

primary_services.value: less-than-truckload freight transportation; freight brokerage; last-mile delivery; managed transportation

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial, retail and commercial shippers and manufacturers

end_markets.value: industrial manufacturing; retail; e-commerce; consumer goods; wholesale distribution

revenue_model.value: service fees: freight shipping charges per shipment, including fuel surcharges and accessorials; project or contract: contracted brokerage and last-mile delivery services

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs LTL terminals, tractors and trailers, hauling shipper freight; service provider: arranges brokered truckload and last-mile delivery for shippers

geography_served.value: global: North America (US, Canada, Mexico) and Europe, mainly the UK, France, Spain and Portugal

specialization.value: related lines: LTL in North America and Europe, plus brokerage and last-mile services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales force serving national and regional shipper accounts; online: digital tools for quoting, booking and tracking shipments

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: trucking safety, hours-of-service and emissions rules from DOT, FMCSA and EU authorities
